title: bee state session release marks the open session not-live until the user returns

truths: bee state session release writes status closed + closed_at + released:true on the resolved session record
A PostToolUse heartbeat does not revive a released record; a UserPromptSubmit revival clears status/closed_at/released and stamps revived_at
is_concurrent_mode and active_worker_session_ids read a released record as not-live

action: New verb `bee state session release` in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/sessions.rs, registered exactly like `session unbind` (run_session_unbind is the template — find its dispatch/help/CLI-schema registration points by rg'ing 'session unbind' and 'unbind' across src, including the cli_shape hook schema if commands are pinned there, and mirror every one). Flags: --session-id optional; resolve via flag then BEE_SESSION_ID then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (reuse claims.rs resolve_session_flag_env or the state_group equivalent). Behavior: under the sessions store lock read the record (missing record: typed no-op result, exit 0), set status:"closed", closed_at:<now ISO>, released:true; atomic write; JSON output {id, released:true, closed_at}. Revival split: in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/state_sync.rs heartbeat_session's revival block, do NOT clear a record whose released is true (leave mark intact, still update last_heartbeat); in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/prompt_context.rs's revival block, DO clear status/closed_at/released (+ stamp revived_at) — the user speaking is the re-engage signal. Session-init already recreates records on SessionStart; verify it clears the mark too (if not, make it). Tests: verb writes the mark (flag and env resolution); state_sync heartbeat leaves a released record marked but updates last_heartbeat; prompt_context revival clears everything and stamps revived_at; a released record reads not-live in claims.rs is_concurrent_mode and write_guard active_worker_session_ids.
intent: A long-lived session holding nothing between tasks still blocks siblings for up to 900s; an explicit release drops the hold instantly and the next user message re-engages automatically.

trace.outcome: Added bee state session release with the state_sync/prompt_context/session_init revival split, registered in set_gate.rs dispatch + router.rs index + registry_payload.json, with unit and CLI-integration tests.
